queries.name: Model Object Hierarchy
text: let
// Load all model objects from the All Models table
Source = #"All Models",
// Keep only the columns needed for the model object hierarchy dimension

#"Removed Other Columns" = Table.SelectColumns(Source,{"Object Type", "Table Name", "Object Name", "Format String", "Display Folder", "Description", "Is Hidden", "Table Storage Mode", "Calculated Column Flag", "Expression", "ModelAsOfDate", "Relationship From Table", "Relationship From Column", "Relationship To Table", "Relationship To Column", "Relationship Status", "Relationship From Cardinality", "Relationship To Cardinality", "Relationship Cross Filtering Behavior", "Dataflow Name", "Dataflow Query Name", "Dataflow Query Expression", "Dataflow ID - Query Name", "Dataflow ID used in Partition", "ModelName - ObjectType - TableName - ObjectName", "Object Type Sort Order", "Model ID", "Workspace Name - Model Name", "Workspace Name - Model ID", "Workspace Name - Dataflow Name", "Model in Workspace Flag", "Model Home Workspace Name", "Workspace Name", "Model Name", "Model Description", "Workspace ID", "Workspace Name - Model ID - Table Name", "WorkspaceName - ModelName - ObjectType - TableName - ObjectName", "Workspace Name - Model ID - Object Type - Table Name - Object Name", "Model Detail Available?", "Report Level Measure Flag", "Report Workspace Name - Model ID - Report ID"}),
// Rename Workspace Name column (identity rename for schema consistency)
#"Renamed Columns" = Table.RenameColumns(#"Removed Other Columns",{{"Workspace Name", "Workspace Name"}}),
// Sort by Calculated Column Flag descending so calculated columns appear first
#"Sorted Rows" = Table.Sort(#"Renamed Columns",{{"Calculated Column Flag", Order.Descending}}),
// Add a sequential index column for row ordering
#"Added Index" = Table.AddIndexColumn(#"Sorted Rows", "Index", 1, 1, Int64.Type),

// We merge Usage at the Model level, not Workspace & Model. Model ID ensures it's still unique to a specific Model but doesn't incorrectly filter out usage based on Workspace. At the Model level, if an object is used anywhere, regardless of workspace, it is used and will affect reports. Exact usage location is via Report detail.

#"Merged Queries" = Table.NestedJoin(#"Added Index", {"WorkspaceName - ModelName - ObjectType - TableName - ObjectName"}, UsedObjects, {"WorkspaceName - ModelName - ObjectType - TableName - ObjectName"}, "UsedObjects", JoinKind.LeftOuter),
// Expand the usage type from the UsedObjects join
#"Expanded UsedObjects" = Table.ExpandTableColumn(#"Merged Queries", "UsedObjects", {"UsageType"}, {"UsageType"}),
// Determine the "Object Used In" value based on object type (Relationships, Measures, Columns, Levels show usage; others show "N/A")

#"Added Conditional Column" = Table.AddColumn(#"Expanded UsedObjects", "Object Used In", each if [Object Type] = "Relationship" then [UsageType] else if [Object Type] = "Measure" then [UsageType] else if [Object Type] = "Column" then [UsageType] else if [Object Type] = "Level" then [UsageType] else "N/A", type text),
// Replace null usage with "Unused" to indicate the object is not referenced anywhere
#"Replaced Value" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Added Conditional Column",null,"Unused",Replacer.ReplaceValue,{"Object Used In"}),
// Create a simplified Used/Unused/N/A flag for the object

#"Added Conditional Column1" = Table.AddColumn(#"Replaced Value", "Object Used Flag", each if [Object Used In] = "N/A" then [Object Used In] else if [Object Used In] = "Unused" then [Object Used In] else "Used", type text),
// Flag whether the object is specifically used in reports
#"Added Custom1" = Table.AddColumn(#"Added Conditional Column1", "Object Used In Reports Flag", each if [Object Used In] <> null
and Text.Contains([Object Used In], "Reports")
then "True"
else "False", type text),
// Restore null values for objects where usage tracking is not applicable
#"Replaced Value1" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Added Custom1","N/A",null,Replacer.ReplaceValue,{"Object Used In", "Object Used Flag"}),
// Remove the temporary UsageType and Index columns
#"Removed Columns1" = Table.RemoveColumns(#"Replaced Value1",{"UsageType", "Index"}),
#"Added Custom2" = Table.AddColumn(#"Removed Columns1", "Model Name - Model ID", each [Model Name]&" - "&[Model ID], type text),
// Trim whitespace from the duplicated key for consistent matching
#"Trimmed Text" = Table.TransformColumns(#"Added Custom2",{{"WorkspaceName - ModelName - ObjectType - TableName - ObjectName", Text.Trim, type text}}),
// Apply proper casing to the duplicated key for standardized comparison
#"Cleaned Text" = Table.TransformColumns(#"Trimmed Text",{{"WorkspaceName - ModelName - ObjectType - TableName - ObjectName", Text.Proper, type text}}),
// Remove duplicate rows based on the standardized composite key copy
#"Removed Duplicates" = Table.Distinct(#"Cleaned Text", {"WorkspaceName - ModelName - ObjectType - TableName - ObjectName"})
in
#"Removed Duplicates"

queries.name: All Reports
text: let
// Load the Visual Objects query as the primary data source
Source = #"Visual Objects",
// Append all other report component tables: Bookmarks, Connections, Custom Visuals, Filters, Pages, Interactions, Visuals
#"Appended Query" = Table.Combine({Source, Bookmarks, Connections, #"Custom Visuals", #"Page Filters", Pages, #"Report Filters", #"Visual Filters", #"Visual Interactions", Visuals}),
// Remove the ServerName column (not needed in final output)
#"Removed Columns" = Table.RemoveColumns(#"Appended Query",{"ServerName"}),
// Replace null filter values with N/A for consistent display
#"Replaced Value" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Removed Columns",null,"N/A",Replacer.ReplaceValue,{"FilterType", "HiddenFilter", "LockedFilter", "AppliedFilter"}),
// Create a Filter Type Detail key combining filter flag and filter type
#"Added Custom" = Table.AddColumn(#"Replaced Value", "Filter Type Detail", each [#"Filter?"]&" - "&[FilterType], type text),
// Create a detailed Filter Detail Key combining all filter attributes
#"Added Custom1" = Table.AddColumn(#"Added Custom", "Filter Detail Key", each [#"Filter?"]&" - "&[FilterType]&" - "&[HiddenFilter]&" - "&[LockedFilter]&" - "&[AppliedFilter], type text),

#"Replaced Value4" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Added Custom1","N/A - N/A","N/A",Replacer.ReplaceValue,{"Filter Type Detail"}),
// Set proper data types for filter details, report date, and page hidden flag
#"Changed Type2" = Table.TransformColumnTypes(#"Replaced Value4",{{"Filter Type Detail", type text}, {"Filter Detail Key", type text}, {"ReportDate", type date}, {"PageHiddenFlag", type text}}),
// Duplicate Original ObjectName to split table and object name components
#"Duplicated Column" = Table.DuplicateColumn(#"Changed Type2", "Original ObjectName", "Original ObjectName - Copy"),
// Split the duplicated column by dot delimiter to separate table from object name

#"Split Column by Delimiter" = Table.SplitColumn(#"Duplicated Column", "Original ObjectName - Copy", Splitter.SplitTextByEachDelimiter({"."}, QuoteStyle.Csv, false), {"Original ObjectName - Copy.1", "Original ObjectName - Copy.2"}),
// Replace empty TableName values with null for conditional logic
#"Replaced Value2" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Split Column by Delimiter","",null,Replacer.ReplaceValue,{"TableName"}),
// Determine Table Name for the visual layer: use TableName if available, otherwise use the split part
#"Added Conditional Column3" = Table.AddColumn(#"Replaced Value2", "Table Name - Visual Layer", each if [TableName] = null then [#"Original ObjectName - Copy.1"] else [TableName], type text),

// Check if the page name contains "isting" (for Listing page detection)
#"Added Conditional Column" = Table.AddColumn(#"Replaced Value1", "Listing Page Check", each if Text.Contains([Page Name], "isting") then "true" else "false", type text),
// Check if the visual name contains "isting" (for Listing visual detection)
#"Added Conditional Column1" = Table.AddColumn(#"Added Conditional Column", "Visual Listing Check", each if Text.Contains([Visual Name], "isting") then "true" else "false", type text),
// Combine the listing page and visual checks into a single flag
#"Added Custom2" = Table.AddColumn(#"Added Conditional Column1", "Custom", each [Listing Page Check]&[Visual Listing Check], type text),
// Determine if a listing visual appears on a non-listing page (anomaly detection)

// Rename remaining columns to final display-friendly names

#"Renamed Columns1" = Table.RenameColumns(#"Added Conditional Column2",{{"Object Type", "Object Type - Visual Layer"}, {"ObjectSource", "Object - Visual Layer"}, {"Filter?", "Filter Type Group"}, {"Category", "Visual Object Category"}, {"CustomVisualName", "Custom Visual Name"}, {"FilterType", "Filter Type"}, {"HiddenFilter", "Hidden Filter"}, {"LockedFilter", "Locked Filter"}, {"AppliedFilter", "Applied Filter"}, {"PageHiddenFlag", "Page Hidden Flag"}, {"PageVisualCount", "Page Visual Count"}, {"PageDimensionsType", "Page Dimensions Type"}, {"VisualHiddenFlag", "Visual Hidden Flag"}, {"ShowItemsNoDataFlag", "Show Items No Data Flag"}, {"WorkspaceName", "WorkspaceName"}}),

#"Removed Columns2" = Table.RemoveColumns(#"Renamed Columns1",{"Original ObjectName - Copy.1", "Original ObjectName - Copy.2", "Custom"}),

#"Filtered Rows" = Table.SelectRows(#"Removed Columns2", each ([#"Object Type - Visual Layer"] <> "")),
// Create composite key: Workspace Name - Model ID

#"Added Custom5" = Table.AddColumn(#"Added Custom4", "WorkspaceName - ModelName - ObjectType - TableName - ObjectName", each [Model Home Workspace Name]&" - "&[ModelName]&" - "&[#"Object Type - Visual Layer"]&" - "&[#"Table Name - Visual Layer"]&" - "&[#"Object Name - Visual Layer"], type text),

#"Added Custom7" = Table.AddColumn(#"Added Custom5", "Workspace Name - Model ID - Table Name", each [WorkspaceName]&" - "&[ModelID]&" - "&[#"Table Name - Visual Layer"], type text),

// Create composite key: ModelID - ObjectType - Table - ObjectName

#"Added Custom10" = Table.AddColumn(#"Added Custom9", "Model Home Workspace Name - Model ID", each [Model Home Workspace Name]&" - "&[ModelID], type text),

#"Trimmed Text" = Table.TransformColumns(#"Added Custom10",{{"Report Object Unique Key", Text.Trim, type text}, {"ModelName - ObjectType - TableName - ObjectName", Text.Trim, type text}, {"WorkspaceName - ModelName - ObjectType - TableName - ObjectName", Text.Trim, type text}, {"ModelID - ObjectType - TableName - ObjectName", Text.Trim, type text}}),

#"Cleaned Text" = Table.TransformColumns(#"Trimmed Text",{{"Report Object Unique Key", Text.Proper, type text}, {"ModelName - ObjectType - TableName - ObjectName", Text.Proper, type text}, {"WorkspaceName - ModelName - ObjectType - TableName - ObjectName", Text.Proper, type text}, {"ModelID - ObjectType - TableName - ObjectName", Text.Proper, type text}})

// Join with Report & Model Mapping to check if model detail is available
#"Merged Queries" = Table.NestedJoin(Source, {"Model Home Workspace Name - Model ID"}, #"Report & Model Mapping", {"Workspace Name - Model ID"}, "Report & Model Mapping", JoinKind.LeftOuter),

#"Expanded Report & Model Mapping" = Table.ExpandTableColumn(#"Merged Queries", "Report & Model Mapping", {"Model Detail Available?"}, {"Model Detail Available?"}),

VisualObjectFilters=let
// SUB-QUERY: Load the original visual filters to identify which objects already have explicit filters
OriginalVisualFilters=let
// Load raw visual filter data from the base report detail query
Source = #"Base Visual Filters",
// Create a workspace-report composite key for joining
#"Added Custom" = Table.AddColumn(Source, "Workspace Name - Report Name", each [WorkspaceName]&" - "&[ReportName], type text),
// Standardize the PageId column name to PageID

#"Cleaned Text" = Table.TransformColumns(#"Trimmed Text",{{"WorkspaceName - ReportName - PageName - VisualId - TableName - ObjectName - Obje", Text.Proper, type text}})
in
#"Cleaned Text",
// Load the visual objects (fields used in visuals) to find implicit filters
Source = #"Base Visuals Objects",
// Create a workspace-report composite key for joining
#"Added Custom" = Table.AddColumn(Source, "Workspace Name - Report Name", each [WorkspaceName]&" - "&[ReportName], type text),

// Standardize the PageId column name to PageID
#"Renamed Columns" = Table.RenameColumns(#"Added Custom1",{{"PageId", "PageID"}}),
// Keep only Column, Hierarchy, and Measure objects (filter-eligible types)
#"Filtered Rows" = Table.SelectRows(#"Renamed Columns", each ([ObjectType] = "Column" or [ObjectType] = "Hierarchy" or [ObjectType] = "Measure")),

#"Removed Other Columns" = Table.SelectColumns(#"Filtered Rows",{"WorkspaceName", "ReportName", "ReportID", "ModelID", "PageName", "PageID", "VisualId", "TableName", "ObjectType", "ObjectName", "DisplayName", "WorkspaceName - ReportName - PageName - VisualId - TableName - ObjectName - Obje", "Workspace Name - Report Name", "ReportDate"}),
#"Trimmed Text" = Table.TransformColumns(#"Removed Other Columns",{{"WorkspaceName - ReportName - PageName - VisualId - TableName - ObjectName - Obje", Text.Trim, type text}}),

// Expand the match key to check for null (unmatched = no existing filter)

#"Expanded Visual Filters" = Table.ExpandTableColumn(#"Merged Queries", "Visual Filters (2)", {"WorkspaceName - ReportName - PageName - VisualId - TableName - ObjectName - Obje"}, {"WorkspaceName - ReportName - PageName - VisualId - TableName - ObjectName - Ob.1"}),

// Assign default filter types based on object type (Categorical for columns/hierarchies, Advanced for measures)

#"Added Custom3" = Table.AddColumn(#"Added Custom2", "LockedFilter", each "", type text),

#"Replaced Value" = Table.TransformColumns(

{"AppliedFilter", each if _ <> "" and _ <> null then "True" else "False", type text},

{"LockedFilter", each if _ <> "" and _ <> null then "True" else "False", type text}

// Preserve the original ObjectName before renaming for lineage tracking

// Preserve the original ObjectType before renaming for lineage tracking

// Replace empty-string ObjectType values with null for consistent handling
#"Replaced Value2" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Renamed Columns2","""""",null,Replacer.ReplaceValue,{"ObjectType"}),
// Create a workspace-report-page navigation key
#"Added Custom3" = Table.AddColumn(#"Replaced Value2", "Workspace Name - Report Name - Page Name", each [WorkspaceName]&" - "&[ReportName]&" - "&[PageName], type text),
// Create a composite key using IDs for precise page matching
#"Added Custom4" = Table.AddColumn(#"Added Custom3", "Workspace Name - ReportID - ModelID - PageName", each [WorkspaceName]&" - "&[ReportID]&" - "&[ModelID]&" - "&[PageName], type text),
// Create a workspace-report-page-visual composite key for visual-level joins
#"Added Custom5" = Table.AddColumn(#"Added Custom4", "Workspace Name - Report Name - Page Name - Visual ID", each [WorkspaceName]&" - "&[ReportName]&" - "&[PageName]&" - "&[VisualId], type text),
// Add a sequential index for row ordering
#"Added Index" = Table.AddIndexColumn(#"Added Custom5", "Index", 1, 1, Int64.Type),
// Create a unique page identifier for page-level joins
#"Added Custom6" = Table.AddColumn(#"Added Index", "UniquePageID", each [WorkspaceName]&" - "&[ReportID]&" - "&[ModelID]&" - "&[PageID], type text),
// Left join with Visuals to get visual position and visibility metadata

#"Merged Queries" = Table.NestedJoin(#"Added Custom6", {"Workspace Name - Report Name - Page Name - Visual ID"}, Visuals, {"Workspace Name - Report Name - Page Name - Visual ID"}, "Visuals", JoinKind.LeftOuter),
// Expand the visual's hidden flag and position/dimension fields

// Define a reusable function that sanitizes text by replacing brackets and removing special characters
CleanName = (s as nullable text) as nullable text =>
let
result =
if s = null then
null
else
let
// Step 1: Replace [ with ( and ] with )
step1 = Text.Replace(Text.Replace(s, "[", "("), "]", ")"),
// Step 2: Define allowed characters (A–Z, a–z, 0–9, ()&,.-)
Allowed =
List.Combine({
List.Transform({65..90}, Character.FromNumber),    // A–Z
List.Transform({97..122}, Character.FromNumber),   // a–z
List.Transform({48..57}, Character.FromNumber),    // 0–9
// Step 3: Replace disallowed chars with a space
step2 =
Text.Combine(
List.Transform(
Text.ToList(step1),
each if List.Contains(Allowed, _) then _ else " "
// Step 4: Trim leading AND trailing spaces
step3 = Text.Trim(step2)
in
step3
in
result
in
CleanName

queries.name: Base Dataflows
text: let
// Load the dataflow query detail from the dataflow Excel workbook
Source = Excel.Workbook(Web.Contents(#"Base Directory" & "\" & #"Base Dataflow File" ), null, true),
// Navigate to the "Sheet1" worksheet
Sheet = Source{[Item="Sheet1",Kind="Sheet"]}[Data],
// Promote the first row to column headers
#"Promoted Headers" = Table.PromoteHeaders(Sheet, [PromoteAllScalars=true]),
// Define the expected column names
ExpectedColumns = {"Dataflow ID", "Dataflow Name", "Query Name", "Query", "Report Date", "Workspace Name - Dataflow Name", "RowError", "RowState", "Table", "ItemArray", "HasErrors"},
// Get the actual column names from the file
ActualColumns = Table.ColumnNames(#"Promoted Headers"),
// Identify missing columns
MissingColumns = List.Difference(ExpectedColumns, ActualColumns),
// Add missing columns as blank (null values)
AddMissingColumns = List.Accumulate(
MissingColumns,
#"Promoted Headers",
(state, current) => Table.AddColumn(state, current, each null)
// Keep only the expected columns (remove any extras)
#"Filtered Columns" = Table.SelectColumns(AddMissingColumns, ExpectedColumns),
// Apply column data types for downstream processing

#"Changed Type" = Table.TransformColumnTypes(#"Filtered Columns",{{"Dataflow ID", type text}, {"Dataflow Name", type text}, {"Query Name", type text}, {"Query", type text}, {"Report Date", type datetime}, {"Workspace Name - Dataflow Name", type text}, {"RowError", type text}, {"RowState", type text}, {"Table", type text}, {"ItemArray", type text}, {"HasErrors", type text}}, Culture.Current),
// Convert the Report Date column to date type
#"Changed Type1" = Table.TransformColumnTypes(#"Changed Type",{{"Report Date", type date}}, Culture.Current),
// Buffer the table in memory for query performance
TableBuffer = Table.Buffer(#"Changed Type1")
in
TableBuffer

queries.name: Base Calculated Column Dependencies
text: let
// Load the calculated column dependency data from the model detail Excel workbook
Source = Excel.Workbook(Web.Contents(#"Base Directory" & "\" & #"Base Model File" ), null, true),
// Navigate to the "Measure Dependencies" worksheet
Sheet = Source{[Item="Measure Dependencies",Kind="Sheet"]}[Data],
// Promote the first row to column headers
#"Promoted Headers" = Table.PromoteHeaders(Sheet, [PromoteAllScalars=true]),
// Define the expected column names
ExpectedColumns = {"ObjectName", "ObjectType", "DependsOn", "DependsOnType", "ModelAsOfDate", "ModelName", "ModelID"},
// Get the actual column names from the file
ActualColumns = Table.ColumnNames(#"Promoted Headers"),
// Identify missing columns
MissingColumns = List.Difference(ExpectedColumns, ActualColumns),
// Add missing columns as blank (null values)
AddMissingColumns = List.Accumulate(
MissingColumns,
#"Promoted Headers",
(state, current) => Table.AddColumn(state, current, each null)
// Keep only the expected columns (remove any extras)
#"Filtered Columns" = Table.SelectColumns(AddMissingColumns, ExpectedColumns),
// Split the combined "WorkspaceName~ModelName" into separate columns
#"Split Column by Delimiter" = Table.SplitColumn(#"Filtered Columns", "ModelName", Splitter.SplitTextByEachDelimiter({"~"}, QuoteStyle.Csv, false), {"ModelName.1", "ModelName.2"}),
// Trim whitespace from ModelID and the split workspace/model name values
#"Trimmed Text" = Table.TransformColumns(#"Split Column by Delimiter",{{"ModelID", Text.Trim, type text}, {"ModelName.1", Text.Trim, type text}, {"ModelName.2", Text.Trim, type text}}),
// Rename the split columns to WorkspaceName and ModelName
#"Renamed Columns" = Table.RenameColumns(#"Trimmed Text",{{"ModelName.2", "ModelName"}, {"ModelName.1", "WorkspaceName"}}),
// Apply column data types for downstream processing

#"Changed Type" = Table.TransformColumnTypes(#"Renamed Columns",{{"ObjectName", type text}, {"ObjectType", type text}, {"DependsOn", type text}, {"DependsOnType", type text}, {"ModelAsOfDate", type date}}, Culture.Current),

//For Pro Workspaces, the Model ID cannot be extracted from the model itself and has "Workspace Name - Model Name" as its Model ID. This merge is used to pull the TRUE Model ID and use for later steps.
#"Merged Queries" = Table.NestedJoin(#"Changed Type", {"ModelID"}, #"Power BI Datasets", {"ModelID"}, "Power BI Datasets", JoinKind.LeftOuter),
// Expand the resolved DatasetId from the Power BI Datasets lookup
#"Expanded Power BI Datasets" = Table.ExpandTableColumn(#"Merged Queries", "Power BI Datasets", {"DatasetId"}, {"DatasetId"}),
// Keep only calculated column-type dependencies (filter out measures)
#"Filtered Rows" = Table.SelectRows(#"Expanded Power BI Datasets", each ([ObjectType] = "CalculatedColumn")),
// Select only the columns needed for calculated column dependency analysis
#"Removed Other Columns" = Table.SelectColumns(#"Filtered Rows",{"ObjectName", "DependsOn", "DependsOnType", "ModelAsOfDate", "WorkspaceName", "ModelName", "ModelID", "DatasetId"}),
// Rename ModelID to OriginalModelID, DatasetId to ModelID (true Model ID), and ObjectName to CalculatedColumn
#"Renamed Columns1" = Table.RenameColumns(#"Removed Other Columns",{{"ModelID", "OriginalModelID"}, {"DatasetId", "ModelID"}, {"ObjectName", "CalculatedColumn"}}),
// Buffer the table in memory for query performance
TableBuffer = Table.Buffer(#"Renamed Columns1")
in
TableBuffer

queries.name: Model Only Check
text: let
// Start from Workspace & Model Mapping to get all known models
Source = #"Workspace & Model Mapping",
// Left join with Report & Model Mapping on Model ID (not Workspace Name - Model ID)
// to find models that have ANY linked report across ALL workspaces
#"Merged Queries" = Table.NestedJoin(Source, {"Workspace Name - Model ID"}, #"Report & Model Mapping", {"Workspace Name - Model ID"}, "Report & Model Mapping", JoinKind.LeftOuter),
// Expand the report composite key to check for matches

#"Expanded Report & Model Mapping" = Table.ExpandTableColumn(#"Merged Queries", "Report & Model Mapping", {"Workspace Name - Model Name - Report Name"}, {"Workspace Name - Model Name - Report Name"}),
// Keep only models with NO linked report in ANY workspace (truly orphaned/standalone models)
#"Filtered Rows" = Table.SelectRows(#"Expanded Report & Model Mapping", each ([#"Workspace Name - Model Name - Report Name"] = null)),
#"Merged Queries1" = Table.NestedJoin(#"Filtered Rows", {"Workspace Name - Model ID"}, #"Report & Model Mapping", {"Model Workspace Name - Model ID"}, "Report & Model Mapping", JoinKind.LeftOuter),
#"Expanded Report & Model Mapping1" = Table.ExpandTableColumn(#"Merged Queries1", "Report & Model Mapping", {"Model Detail Available?"}, {"Model Detail Available?"}),
#"Replaced Value1" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Expanded Report & Model Mapping1",null,"Model Only - All Reports in Other Workspaces",Replacer.ReplaceValue,{"Model Detail Available?"}),
// Remove columns not needed for the model-only output
#"Removed Columns" = Table.RemoveColumns(#"Replaced Value1",{"DatasetDescription", "Workspace Name - Model Name - Report Name", "Workspace ID", "OriginalModelID", "Workspace Name - Model Name"}),
// Create a UniquePageID using the workspace-model composite key for downstream joins
#"Added Custom" = Table.AddColumn(#"Removed Columns", "UniquePageID", each [#"Workspace Name - Model ID"], type text)
in
#"Added Custom"

queries.name: RLS Expression Parsing
text: let
Source = (expression as nullable text) as table =>
let
Source =
if expression = null
then ""
else expression,
// QUOTED TABLE REFERENCES
// Handles:
// 'Hello Table'
// 'Hello Table'[Column]
SplitByQuote =
Text.Split(Source, "'"),
IndexedQuoteParts =
Table.AddIndexColumn(
Table.FromList(
SplitByQuote,
Splitter.SplitByNothing(),
{"Text"}
"Index",
Int64.Type
QuotedTableParts =
Table.SelectRows(
IndexedQuoteParts,
each Number.Mod([Index], 2) = 1
AddFollowingText =
Table.AddColumn(
QuotedTableParts,
"FollowingText",
each
try SplitByQuote{[Index] + 1}
otherwise "",
type text
AddQuotedColumn =
Table.AddColumn(
AddFollowingText,
"Column",
each
let
FollowingText =
Text.TrimStart([FollowingText])
in
if Text.StartsWith(FollowingText, "[")
then
try
Text.BetweenDelimiters(
FollowingText,
otherwise
null
else
null,
type nullable text
RenameQuotedTable =
Table.RenameColumns(
AddQuotedColumn,
{{"Text", "Table"}}
AddQuotedMeasure =
Table.AddColumn(
RenameQuotedTable,
"Measure",
each null,
type nullable text
SelectQuotedColumns =
Table.SelectColumns(
AddQuotedMeasure,
"Table",
"Column",
"Measure"
RemoveInvalidQuotedTables =
Table.SelectRows(
SelectQuotedColumns,
each
[Table] <> null
and Text.Trim([Table]) <> ""
// REMOVE QUOTED TABLE REFERENCES
// Also removes the qualified column following a quoted
// table so it is not mistaken for a measure.
QuotePartIndexes =
List.Positions(SplitByQuote),
CleanedQuoteParts =
List.Transform(
QuotePartIndexes,
(CurrentIndex) =>
if Number.Mod(CurrentIndex, 2) = 1
then
else
let
CurrentText =
SplitByQuote{CurrentIndex},
FollowsQuotedTable =
CurrentIndex > 0
and Number.Mod(CurrentIndex - 1, 2) = 1,
TrimmedText =
Text.TrimStart(CurrentText),
StartsWithColumn =
FollowsQuotedTable
and Text.StartsWith(
TrimmedText,
RemainingText =
if StartsWithColumn
then
try
Text.AfterDelimiter(
TrimmedText,
otherwise
else
CurrentText
in
RemainingText
UnquotedExpression =
Text.Combine(CleanedQuoteParts, " "),
// FIND BRACKET REFERENCES
// Handles:
// Hello[Column]
// [Measure]
CharacterPositions =
List.Positions(
Text.ToList(UnquotedExpression)
OpeningBracketPositions =
List.Select(
CharacterPositions,
each
Text.Middle(
UnquotedExpression,
BracketReferenceRecords =
List.RemoveNulls(
List.Transform(
OpeningBracketPositions,
(OpeningPosition) =>
let
TextAfterOpening =
Text.Range(
UnquotedExpression,
OpeningPosition + 1
ClosingOffset =
Text.PositionOf(
TextAfterOpening,
ObjectName =
if ClosingOffset >= 0
then
Text.Start(
TextAfterOpening,
ClosingOffset
else
null,
TextBeforeOpening =
Text.Start(
UnquotedExpression,
OpeningPosition
TrimmedBeforeOpening =
Text.TrimEnd(TextBeforeOpening),
PreviousCharacter =
if Text.Length(TrimmedBeforeOpening) > 0
then
Text.End(
TrimmedBeforeOpening,
else
IsLetter =
PreviousCharacter <> ""
and Text.Contains(
"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz",
PreviousCharacter
IsNumber =
PreviousCharacter <> ""
and Text.Contains(
PreviousCharacter
HasUnquotedTable =
IsLetter
or IsNumber
or PreviousCharacter = "_",
ReverseBeforeOpening =
Text.Reverse(
TrimmedBeforeOpening
TableDelimiterPosition =
Text.PositionOfAny(
ReverseBeforeOpening,
TableNameLength =
if TableDelimiterPosition = -1
then Text.Length(ReverseBeforeOpening)
else TableDelimiterPosition,
UnquotedTableName =
if HasUnquotedTable
then
Text.Reverse(
Text.Start(
ReverseBeforeOpening,
TableNameLength
else
null
in
if ObjectName = null
or Text.Trim(ObjectName) = ""
then
null
else if HasUnquotedTable
then
Table =
Text.Trim(UnquotedTableName),
Column =
Text.Trim(ObjectName),
Measure = null
else
Table = null,
Column = null,
Measure =
Text.Trim(ObjectName)
BracketReferences =
if List.IsEmpty(BracketReferenceRecords)
then
#table(
type table [
Table = nullable text,
Column = nullable text,
Measure = nullable text
else
Table.FromRecords(
BracketReferenceRecords,
type table [
Table = nullable text,
Column = nullable text,
Measure = nullable text
Combined =
Table.Combine(
RemoveInvalidQuotedTables,
BracketReferences
RemoveInvalid =
Table.SelectRows(
Combined,
each
[Table] <> null
or [Column] <> null
or [Measure] <> null
RemoveDuplicates =
Table.Distinct(RemoveInvalid)
in
RemoveDuplicates
in
Source
